title: The Border Fords & Weeping Ossuary
summary: Map I: The Border Fords & Weeping Ossuary
infobox: Vanguard Company, Salt-Tithe Host, Neutral, Frontier Wardens

p: From the fortified timber palisades of Thornwick Market, march across six interconnected frontier regions to break High Quartermaster Morvessa's Salt-Tithe cordon, purge the Weeping Ossuary beneath Ravenwatch Keep, and open the southern road to Redmarsh.

title: The Redmarsh Wastes & Ironheart Cisterns
summary: Map II: The Redmarsh Wastes & Ironheart Cisterns
infobox: Vanguard Company, Ironheart & Salt-Coven Host, Neutral, Redmarsh Caravaneers

p: Operating from the limestone stilt-stockade of Redmarsh Outpost, rescue the bogged supply convoy, silence the crossfire at Twin Passes, ground the three ruptured Quartz Wardstones, spark the Deep Quarry prisoner revolt, and storm the twin causeways of Ironheart Bastion to confront Gorrathul.

title: The Iron Coast & Drowned Citadel
summary: Map III: The Iron Coast & Drowned Citadel
infobox: Expeditionary Vanguard, Black Fleet Blockade, Neutral, Oakhaven Maritime Guild

p: From the storm-lashed drydocks of Oakhaven Harbor, enforce the Bailey Truce across six coastal regions: drain the Greywash Canal locks, extract the stranded vanguard on Hourglass Spit, silence the Drowned Choir inside the Sunken Citadel, range the cliffside bronze culverins, and board Lord Admiral Vesperion's burning flagship at Harborwatch.

title: The Obsidian Caldera & Cinder Throne
summary: Map IV: The Obsidian Caldera & Cinder Throne
infobox: Expeditionary Vanguard, Caldera Warden Host, Neutral, First Watch Remnant

p: From the geothermal quenching trenches of Ironcamp Forge-Hold, march down the Basalt Highway to relight the Shattered Beacons, run Arch-Mage Malrik down on the Ashveil Summit stairs, breach the Gauntlet of Iron, hold Three-Roads Watch, choose Thornvael's destiny at the Crossroads of Headless Kings, and ascend the Obsidian Dais to face First Warden Ashkarath.
